lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let q := ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let m := mulLinearMap (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  suffices h : (m.comp (m.flip c)).compr₂ (q.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF) =
      m.compr₂ (q.toLinearMap.comp ((m c).comp timeOrderF)) from
    LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h a b
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs'
  apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
  intro φs
  change q 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * c * ofCrAnListFBasis φs) =
    q (c * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * ofCrAnListFBasis φs))
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  let s := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
  let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
    s) ++
    (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs')
  let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
    (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    s)
  have ht (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (hl : ∀ c ∈ l,
      crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
      𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF l * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ l ++ φs) •
        (ofCrAnListF l1 * ofCrAnListF l * ofCrAnListF l2) := by
    rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
      insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
    simp [ofCrAnListF_append, l1, l2, s, mul_assoc]
  have h0 := ht [] (by simp)
  simp at h0
  have h12 := ht [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  have h21 := ht [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
  simp [ofCrAnListF_cons] at h12 h21
  rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ] at h21
  trans q (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (ofCrAnListF l1 * c * ofCrAnListF l2))
  · apply congrArg q
    simp only [c, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, mul_sub, sub_mul,
      Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, timeOrderF.map_sub,
      timeOrderF.map_smul, h12, h21, smul_sub]
    rw [smul_comm]
  simp only [map_smul q, map_mul q]
  rw [ (show ∀ x, x * q c = q c * x from Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
      (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)), mul_assoc, ← map_mul q]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
      hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign, h0, map_smul q, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  · simp only [(show q c = 0 from ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq), zero_mul,
      smul_zero]
